name: M51 (Hubble)
blurb: M51, the Whirlpool Galaxy, a grand-design spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: m51-hubble
story: The Whirlpool's spiral arms are star-formation factories, compressing hydrogen gas and building clusters of new stars. Hubble came here to pick out individual red giant stars and settle how far away the galaxy really is.

claims.text: M51, the Whirlpool Galaxy, is a spiral galaxy
M51's spiral arms are star-formation factories that compress hydrogen gas and create clusters of new stars
M51 is cataloged as NGC 5194, is nicknamed the Whirlpool and is a grand-design spiral
Hubble program 13804 measures accurate tip-of-the-red-giant-branch distances to nearby SINGS spirals, including M51
